title: Rank concepts several ways
description: Named ranks, not one score: most mentioned; most sources (distinct sites, so one blog cannot win); most valued by editors (stars, votes, tags); most connected (PageRank over the PMI-weighted co-occurrence graph, replacing or feeding `recompute-authority`); bridges (betweenness: concepts joining otherwise separate areas). Derived numbers go on the node through the derived-fields patch; the full lists go to the snapshot. Publish a file `concept-ranks.json` with the parameters.
